# UCEOU SIH 2026 Internal Selection Hackathon
> The official campus-level internal selection round for the Smart India Hackathon 2026, hosted by the University College of Engineering, Osmania University (UCEOU), Hyderabad.

## About the Hackathon
The UCEOU SIH 2026 Internal Hackathon selects and nominates top student engineering teams to represent Osmania University on the national Smart India Hackathon portal.

- **Institution:** University College of Engineering, Osmania University (UCEOU)
- **Location:** Assembly Hall, UCEOU Main Campus, Hyderabad, Telangana 500007, India
- **Dates:** 
  - Phase 1 Pitching: September 2–3, 2026
  - Phase 2 Final Selection Pitching: September 11, 2026
- **Format:** In-person presentation (5-minute pitch + 5-minute jury Q&A)
- **Official Website:** https://sih-ouce.meetthealtezza.tech

## Eligibility & Rules
1. **Team Size:** Strictly 6 members from UCEOU.
2. **Diversity Requirement:** At least 1 female member is mandatory per team.
3. **Problem Statements:** Teams can select up to 2 problem statements (Primary and Secondary) from the 226 official SIH 2026 challenges.
4. **Slide Deck Format:** Mandatory 6-slide presentation (Title, Idea & Solution, Technical Approach, Feasibility, Impact & Benefits, Research & References).
5. **Tools Permitted:** AI coding tools and LLMs are allowed, provided all team members can fully defend their technical architecture during jury evaluation.
